name: spines-and-spins
description: A whimsical book-club spinner for iOS and Android.

scripts.release:check: npm run build:web && node --check app-v2.js && node scripts/release-check.mjs
scripts.sync:ios: npm run build:web && npx cap sync ios
scripts.open:ios: npm run sync:ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.run:ios: npm run sync:ios && npx cap run ios
